field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Whether this store view pushes orders to LaunchOMS. Set automatically when you enable this store from LaunchOMS's Marketplace > Magento -- flip it off here to pause a store without changing anything on the LaunchOMS side.

field.label: LaunchOMS URL
field.comment: Your LaunchOMS instance, e.g. https://app.launchoms.example -- shown alongside the connection token in LaunchOMS's Marketplace > Magento > "Connect a Magento store".

field.label: Connection Token
field.comment: One-time token from LaunchOMS's Marketplace > Magento > "Connect a Magento store". Paste it here and click Save Config -- this store pairs with your LaunchOMS account automatically (store list, webhook URL/secret, and inventory sync all get set up with no further manual config). The token is single-use and expires after 15 minutes; it's cleared here once used.

field.label: Request timeout (seconds)
field.comment: How long to wait for LaunchOMS to accept the order. Checkout never blocks on this call failing or timing out -- it's logged and dropped, not retried inline.
